texts.preamble: Gourav K vs Linith Clark on 11 September, 2025 Kabc030794082021 In The Court Of The Xlviii Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Bengaluru Dated: This The 11th Day Of September 2025
texts.facts: UPSHOT OF THE CASE Accused is acquitted of the alleged charges JUDGMENT This judgment is the outcome of the final report filed by the PI of Halsuru Gate Police Station, Bengaluru against the accused No.1 to 4 for the offences punishable U/s. 304(A), 337 and 338 R/w 34 of Indian Penal Code. 2. Brief Facts Of The Case Of Prosecution:- The case of prosecution is that, accused No.1 is the owner of Madhu Agency and the accused No.2 is the manager of the said agency. Accused No.3 and 4 are the workers/employees of the said Madhu Agency which supplies C.C. No.29990/2021 LPG Gas. The deceased by name Krishnashetty was the customer of said Madhu Agency under customer No.444693. On 07.07.2021 at about 2.00 pm in the house of 1 st floor building No.10, TRS Lane, Nagara pet the customer Krishnashetty had filed a complaint before the Madhu Gas Agency for non supply of gas cylinder. The accused No.1, 3 and 4 without taking necessary precautions in repair of the gas cylinder and without sending any proper expert to deal with such issue, the accused No.2 was sent for repair of the gas cylinder. It is further alleged that, when the deceased insisted the accused No.2 to change the cylinder, the accused No.2 negligently and being irresponsible did not change the cylinder and left open the LPG gas cylinder in the house. As a result the LPG cylinder blast and the deceased Krishnashetty suffered 40% of burn injuries and succumbed to the said injuries on 15.07.2021 at 12.08 hours at St. John Medical Hospital, Bengaluru. CW.2 sustained fracture injuries to her right hand and CW.2 sustained 25% burn injuries. The CW.3 sustained 36% burn injuries on her body and CW.4 sustained 18 % burn injuries as well as grievous head injuries in the said blast. It is further alleged that, the C.C. No.29990/2021 aforesaid incident occurred due to the negligence of accused No.1 to 4 and thereby the accused No.1 to 4 in furtherance of common intention have committed the alleged offences punishable under Sections 304(A), 337 and 338 R/w 34 of Indian Penal Code. 3. In response to court summons the accused No.1 to 4 appeared through their counsel Sri. R.A. and have been enlarged on bail. Cognizance was taken for the alleged offences. The prosecution papers Gourav K vs Linith Clark on 11 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49557901/ 2 have been furnished to the accused persons through their counsels as contemplated U/s 207 Cr.P.C. Heard before framing of Charges. Charges were framed, read over and explained to the accused Nos.1 to 4 in Kannada language known to them, having understood the same they pleaded not guilty of offence and claimed to be tried. During pending of the case, the accused No.2 died and case against accused No.2 was abated. 4. As per the charge sheet the prosecution has cited 36 witnesses. Out of these witnesses the prosecution has examined 16 witness as PW-1 to PW.16 and Ex.P-1 to Ex.P- 27 are marked. CW.1 complainant by name Gowrav. K is C.C. No.29990/2021 examined as PW.1, CW.2 by name Gajendra.K injured is examined as PW.2, CW.3 by name Radha injured is examined as PW.3, CW.4 by name Dakshin Thrijal injured is examined as PW.4, CW.5 by name Lakshmi Narayanasheety eye witness is examined as PW.5, CW.9 by name Babutram witness is examined as PW.6, CW.10 by name Manjunath witness is examined as PW.7, CW.11 by name Gagan witness is examined as PW.8, CW.18 by name B.K. Krishnamurthy mahazar witness is examined as PW.9, CW.12 by name Dr. Krupa is examined as PW.10, CW.36 by name Mallikarjun PSI is examined as PW.11, CW.35 by name Savitha PSI is examined as PW.12, CW.19 by name Venkateshchari mahazar witness is examined as PW.13, CW.20 by name Sigamani employee of gas agency is examined as PW.14, CW.22 by name Chandrashekar. H H.C of Halsur Gate Police Station is examined as PW.15, CW.21 by name Sharavana gas agency employee is examined as PW.16. 5. In support of their case, the prosecution has produced the documentary evidence marked as Ex.P.1 to P.27. Ex. P.1 is the complaint given by injured Gourav, Ex.P.2 C.C. No.29990/2021 is the spot mahazar, Ex.P.3 is the FIR, Ex.P.4 and Ex.P.5 are the photographs of stove, Ex .P.6 and Ex.P.7 are the photographs of cylinder, Ex.P.8 is the wound certificate of Gajendra, Ex.P.9 is the wound certificate of Gourav, Ex.P.10 is the property form, Ex.P.11 is the seizure mahazar, Ex.P.12 is the notice given to panchas, Ex.P.13 is the requisition given to PWD, Ex.P.14 is the requisition given by the Police to medical officer St. John Hospital, Ex.P.15 is the postmortem report, Ex.P.16 is the discharge record of Radha. Ex.P.22 is the intimation regarding medico legal case, Ex.P.23 is the requisition given by the Halsur Gate Police to the court, Ex.P.24 is the summons issued to witnesses, Ex.P.25 is the requisition postmortem report, Ex.P.26 is the requisition for postmortem and Ex.P.27 is the dead body acceptance receipt. C.C. No.29990/2021 6. Statement of accused No.1, 3 and 4 under Section 313 was recorded and incriminating evidence in the case of prosecution was read over to the accused No.1, 3 and 4. The accused No.1, 3 and 4 have denied the incriminating evidence against them and submitted that, they have no defense evidence. Accused No.2 and 4 are the workers/employees of the said Gourav K vs Linith Clark on 11 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49557901/ 4 Madhu Agencies, which supplies LPG Gas cylinder. It is stated that, the deceased by name Krishnashetty was the customer of said Madhu Agency under customer No.444693. On 07.07.2021 at about 2.00 pm in the house of 1st floor building No.10, TRS Lane, Nagarapet, the customer Krishnashetty had filed a complaint before the Madhu Gas Agency for non supply of gas cylinder. The accused No.1, 3 and 4 without taking necessary precautions in repair of the said gas cylinder and without sending any proper expert to deal with such issue, the accused No.2 was sent for repair fo the gas cylinder. As a result the LPG gas C.C. No.29990/2021 cylinder blast and the deceased Krishnashetty suffered 40% of burn injuries and succumbed to the said injuries on 15.07.2021 at 12.08 hours at St. John Medical Hospital, Bengaluru. CW4 sustained head injury and 20% burning injury. Immediately his neighbors and relatives rushed inside their house and shifted them to Marthas Hospital. They were given first aid in said hospital and then they were shifted to C.C. No.29990/2021 Victoria Hospital for further treatment. The said incident occurred due to negligence of accused No.2. Accused No.1 is owner of Madhu Agencies. accused No.4 is the area incharge and accused No.3 is the Manager of Madhu Agency. He identified the accused No.2 present before court. On next day, he had shifted his father to St. Johns Hospital and after about one week he succumbed to above burning injuries. K the injured is examined as PW.2. He has deposed that, on 06.07.2021, they were had booked an Indane Company LPG Cylinder from Madhu Agency and on same day they received said cylinder to their house. On 07.07.2021 morning, the previous cylinder Gourav K vs Linith Clark on 11 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49557901/ 5 was exhausted and his father had connected newly delivered gas cylinder to the stove. He noticed that there was no proper supply of gas from said new cylinder to the stove as the flame was low. Immediately his brothers Gourav and Gagan went to their gas supplier by name Madhu Agency of our area. His area incharge accused No.4 intimated that they are receiving similar complaints and they will get it replaced by afternoon. At about 1.20 PM, CW.2, CW.2's father, mother and his son C.C. No.29990/2021 and PW1 had gathered during for lunch. At that time, accused No.2 came to the house with a new cylinder for replacement, but before that he stated that he would check the same. He used his pen on the nozzle of the previous cylinder and there was a gas leak. His father insisted him not to do such act and asked him to replace the cylinder. Though he agreed to replace it, on next second he ignited the stove, which resulted in heavy blast. He sustained grevious fracture in his right hand, CW.2's father suffered 45% burn injury and subsequently he expired due to sepsis infection due to burns. CW.2's mother sustained 25 - 30% of burn injuries. CW.2's son suffered head injury and 20% burn injuries. PW1 suffered 20% burn injuries in above incident. The neighbors took them to Marthas Hospital, where they received First aid. The said hospital shifted them to Victoria Hospital, but his treatment continued in Marathas Hospital itself as he had suffered fracture injury. Later for better treatment they shifted others to St. Johns hospital. The aforesaid blast occurred due to supply of defective quality cylinder and also due to negligence of accused No.2 Gurupadappa. He identified accused No.2 present before C.C. No.29990/2021 court. He was regularly visiting his house to attend such problems. 14. The CW-3 by name Radha is examined as PW.3. She has deposed that, CW1 and CW.2 are her sons. CW4 is her grand son. CW5 to CW.8 are her relatives. Since 2 years the cylinders provided by the Madhu Agency were not proper. Thereafter they requested them to change the cylinder. Accordingly, the representative of Madhu Agency came to their home. Though, he had brought another cylinder he did not fit the same. Once again he installed the earlier cylinder. At that time, there was leakage, the representative flamed the gas, due to that the fire accident took place. In the said incident, her husband suffered burnt injury about 50 to 60%. She sustained 35% of the burn injury. CW1 sustained 20% and CW2 sustained fracture injury for this right hand. CW4 also sustained injury of 10%. Accordingly, her son has given the Complaint against the Accused persons. C.C. No.29990/2021 15. CW.4 by name Dakshin Thrijal is examined as PW.4. He has deposed that, CW1 is his uncle and CW2 is his father and CW3 is his grand mother. He know CW5 to CW.8. The deceased is his grand father. In the month of July 2021, he was attending his online class on 8.00 AM to 01.00 PM. When he came inside to have food on the 1 st Floor at that time CW1 to CW.3 and his grand father were present. One person came to change the defective cylinder by keeping the new cylinder outside. He was trying to open the pin of the old cylinder and trying to light it. At that time, he heard heavy sound, due to that he fell towards to the pooja room and sustained head injuries. His grand father died due to the injuries. His father sustained fracture and CW1 and CW3 sustained burnt injuries. He had stated the same to the police. He identified the accused No.2. Gourav K vs Linith Clark on 11 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49557901/ 6 16. CW.5 by name Lakshminarayana Setty, the retired Bank Employee is examined as PW.5. He has deposed that the deceased Krishnaiah Shetty is his elder brother. CW1 to CW.4 are children, wife and grand son of deceased. CW6 is his wife. CW.7 is her daughter. CW.8 is sister of CW6. On C.C. No.29990/2021 07.07.2021, his brother was trying to install the new cylinder, as it was not good he called the gas agency to exchange the said cylinder. Accused No.2 had come from the agency and they told him to change the cylinder. Instead of changing, he was repairing the old cylinder. Due to which, there was leakage and accident took place. Due to that, CW.1 and CW.3 sustained burnt injury, CW.2 sustained fracture, CW.4 got head injury and his brother passed away. He identified accused No.2. 17. CW.9 by name Babutharam is examined as PW.6. He has deposed that, he have a shop in Bangalore's Nagarpet. Krishnaiah Shetty is the owner. He is on the 1 st floor and his shop is on the ground floor. About 03 years ago, in July, at 2 pm, he had come to Krishnaiah Shetty's house to supply the cylinders. Within 5-10 minutes, he heard a loud noise from the house and the window glass was broken. Later, when he went to the house and saw that the front door was broken. Krishnaiah Shetty's body was completely burnt, his wife and children were also burnt. All the things in the house were scattered. The neighbors came and took him to C.C. No.29990/2021 the hospital. After 2 days, he came to know that Krishnaiah Shetty died while undergoing treatment in the hospital. He has stated that, he cannot say at whose fault the gas accident took place, but when he went to check it, they said that it could have been a leakage or a short circuit. One day, a man came to deliver gas. 18. CW.10 by name Manjunath. B.E is examined as PW.7. He has deposed that he is running a Naveen Jewelery shop in Nagaratpet, Bangalore. Krishnaiah Shetty is its owner. He lives on the 1st floor and his shop is on the ground floor. About 03 years ago at afternoon, while he was working in the shop, he heard a loud noise and a scream from the house. The window glass had broken and fell on the road. Later, when he went to the house, the front door was broken. Krishnaiah Shetty's body was completely burnt, his wife and children's bodies were also burnt. While repairing the gas in his house, it was found that the gas had exploded due to a leak. He saw the person who came to repair it. He was from a gas agency. Then the neighbors came and took him to the hospital. After C.C. No.29990/2021 2 days, he heard that Krishnaiah Shetty died after unsuccessful treatment at the hospital. He has stated that, since it has been almost 3 years, he cannot identify the accused. 19. CW.11 by name Gagan. K is examined as PW.8. He has deposed that, the his father died on 07.07.2024 due to cylinder blast in their home situated at Nagarpet Thimmarayashetty Layout. There are total 4 floors and in the ground floor there are 8 shops. They reside in 1 st floor. At the time of incident, CW.1 to CW.4 and Lakshmi were in the house. He has further deposed that, on 07.07.2024 as the regulator of the said cylinder was not working, hence they had called Madhu Agencies and the said agencies sent Gurupada to their house for repairing the cylinder. The said Gurupada came to their house with one cylinder and at that time CW.1 to CW.4 were present in the house and he was in his office, which is at a distance of 100 meters from the house. The said Gurupada had crossed his office and after 15 to 20 minutes he heard a huge blast sound and when he went to the spot he found that his father had sustained burn C.C. No.29990/2021 injuries and all Gourav K vs Linith Clark on 11 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49557901/ 7 the persons who were at the home had also sustained burn injuries. The doors windows and materials in the house were also damaged and scattered everywhere. The injured were taken to St. Marthas Hospital and from there they were shifted to Victoria Hospital. On the same night, his mother and niece were admitted to St. John Hospital. He has further deposed that his father succumbed to the burn injuries and postmortem was conducted. He has further deposed that, his father told him that the said incident occurred due to the fault of person who had come to repair the regulator. He identified the accused. 20. CW.18 by name B.K. Krishnamurthy is examined as PW.9. He has deposed that, in his presence panchanama was conducted about the incident that took place on 07.07.2021. He identified his signature in Ex.P.2. He has turned partly hostile to the case of prosecution. 21. CW.12 by name Krupa D/o Lakshminarayana Shetty is examined as PW.10. She has deposed that, deceased Krishnaiaha Shetty is her uncle and he was residing in opposite house. On 07.07.2021 in the afternoon C.C. No.29990/2021 they had informed the Gas Agency about the leakage of the gas and at about 2.00 pm, accused No.2 had come to the house of Krishnashetty. When the accused No.2 ignited the stove with the lighter, the blast occurred due to which CW.1 to CW.4 sustained burnt injuries. Later, with the help of neighbors the injured were shifted to Marthas Hospital. Krishnaiah Shetty died in St. John Hospital on 17.07.2021 at about 12.08 am as he has sustained 40% of burn injuries. She has further deposed that, the incident took place due to the negligence of said agency and accused No.2. 22. CW.36 by name Mallikarjuna. N.C the PSI is examined as PW.11. He has deposed that, on 08.07.2021 at about 12.10 am CW.22 recorded the statement of injured in the hospital and came to the Station and lodged the complaint. The same was registered in Cr.No.125/2021 and FIR was submitted to the Court. He identified Ex.P.3. He conducted mahazar as per Ex.P.2 in the presence of CW.18 and CW.19 as CW.22 has shown the place of incident. At the time of mahazar he seized gas stove Indane Gas Cylinder. He submitted PF to the Court. He identified Ex.P.4 to Ex.P.6. C.C. No.29990/2021 The gas cylinder was handed over to the gas agency. He identified Ex.P.7. He received MLC report of CW.2 from Marthas Hospital which is at Ex.P.8. He received the MLC report of CW.1 from Apollo Hospital which is at Ex.P.9. On the same day, recorded the statement of CW.2 and CW.5 to CW.10. On 08.07.2021 he issued notice to the accused No.1 and 3 and released them on bail. On 20.07.2021 he recorded the statement of CW.4. On 28.07.2021 the accused No.3 came to the Station and handed over the LPG gas regulator and in the presence of CW.20 and CW.21 the mahazar was conducted from 5.00 pm to 5.45 pm. He submitted Ex.P.10 to the Court and also identified Ex.,P.11, Ex.P.12 and Ex.P.4. He has further deposed that, on 03.08.2021 he recorded the statement of CW.3 and asked the PWD Department to prepare the sketch of the place of incident and issued a letter to them which is at Ex.P.13. He identified Ex.P.13 to Ex.P.15. He received the discharge summary report of Radha and Dakshin Thrijal from St. John Hospital as per Ex.P.16 and Ex.P.17 and discharge summery report of Gajendra from St. Marthas Hospital as Ex.P.18. He further deposed that, similarly he have received the discharge summary of Gaurav C.C. No.29990/2021 from Apollo Hospital. It was marked as Ex.P.19. He received the map from PWD on 18.09.2021. The covering letter and the map were marked as Ex.P.20. The accused No.2 and 4 have appeared on Gourav K vs Linith Clark on 11 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49557901/ 8 anticipatory bail and have been released on police bail. He further deposed that, he obtained certified copy of the house gas book from the complainant. It was identified as Ex.P.21. The accused No.1 was the owner of Madhu Agency, the accused No.3 was manager and the accused No.2 and 4 were working in the business of supplying gas from house to house. Although the accused No.2 did not have any gas repair skills, the accused No.1 had sent him from Madhu Agency for repair. He came to the deceased's house and tried unscientifically to press the pin on the gas cylinder with a pen and did so despite knowing that such things should not be done at home, which is why the accident occurred. This accident could not have happened due to the negligence of the accused of Madhu Agency as they did not take any precautions. The gas cylinder was leaking and even though the complainant said not to light the lighter, the accused No.2 lit it and this accident happened. C.C. No.29990/2021 23. CW.35 by name Savitha R Jambagi the PSI is examined as PW.12. She has deposed that, she has received the death intimation of the deceased from St. John's Hospital on 15.07.2021. The said death intimation was marked as Ex.P.22. On the same day, she has made a request to the court to apply Section 304A. The said request was marked as Ex.P.23 and signed as Ex.P.23A. She has further deposed that, she has given notice to the coroner. The said notice was marked as Ex.P.24. Thereafter, she has conducted the postmortem examination of the deceased in the presence of the coroner at St. John's Hospital from 9.00 to 10.30 AM. The postmortem report was marked as Ex.P.25 and signed as Ex.P.25A. On the same day, she has requested the doctor to conduct postmortem examination. The said request was marked as Ex.P.26. She appointed CW.23 to escort the body. Then after the receipt of postmortem report she handed over the body of the deceased to Gajendra. The body acceptance receipt was marked as Ex.P.27. He has deposed that, his shop is opposite the house of the deceased in Nagarat Peya. On 08.07.2021, around 10.00 to 11.30 am, a gas explosion was reported and the cylinder and the stove were seized. He identified MO.1 and MO.2. 25.
